object.name: mc.evi.bands~
object.digest: Evenly distribute resonant filter bands across a spectrum
object.description: An evieve version of the native <o>mc.bands~</o> abstraction. In evieve the filters are updated to use TPT resonant filters, as well as some minor optimisations and utilities.

inlets.description: The number of filter bands to create.
The lowest filter band is set at this frequency in Hz.
The highest filter band is set at this frequency in Hz.
The bandwidth of all filter bands. 0% is very narrow, 100% is very wide.

outlets.description: The audio output, an X channel multichannel signal with X bands.

arguments.name: bands
arguments.description: The number of filter bands to create.

arguments.name: low
arguments.description: The lowest filter band is set at this frequency in Hz.

arguments.name: high
arguments.description: The highest filter band is set at this frequency in Hz.

arguments.name: bandwidth
arguments.description: The bandwidth of all filter bands. 0% is very narrow, 100% is very wide.

messages.name: bandwidth
messages.digest: In left inlet, the message 'bandwidth' followed by an int or float
messages.description: In left inlet, the message 'bandwidth' followed by an int or float 0..100 sets the bandwidth of the filters in %.

attributes.name: compensate
attributes.description: Gain compensation flag 0/1 to account for resonant filters at very high Q values.

attributes.name: maxbands
attributes.description: Maximum avilable bands (that the multichannelsignal can use)

attributes.name: smooth
attributes.description: Smoothing time in ms for the filter mixing gains.

attributes.name: tuning
attributes.description: Tuning for the Hz calculations of all filter bands around A = 440
